entries.answer: Wa Alaikum Assalam! Main Ayna hoon, aapki AI voice assistant. Aaj main aapki kya madad kar sakti hoon?
entries.question: Assalam-o-Alaikum

entries.answer: Hello! Main Ayna hoon. Aap mujh se sawal pooch sakte hain, ya mujh se WhatsApp message, call aur reminder ka kaam le sakte hain.
entries.question: Hello Ayna

entries.answer: Main bilkul theek hoon, shukriya! Aap kaise hain? Aaj aapke liye kya kar sakti hoon?
entries.question: Aap kaise ho?

entries.answer: Alhamdulillah, sab theek hai! Aap batayein, kya haal hai? Koi sawal ho ya koi kaam ho to batayein.
entries.question: Kya haal hai?

entries.answer: Aapka bhi shukriya! Khushi hui aapki madad karke. Aur kuch chahiye to zaroor batayein.
entries.question: Shukriya

entries.answer: Khuda Hafiz! Aapka din acha guzre. Jab bhi zaroorat ho, mujhe bula lein — bas 'Ayna' kehna hai.
entries.question: Alvida / Khuda Hafiz

entries.answer: Subah Bakhair! Aapka din khushgawar guzre. Aaj ka koi kaam ya reminder set karna ho to batayein.
entries.question: Subah Bakhair

entries.answer: Shab Bakhair! Aaram se soyein. Kal subah ke liye koi reminder chahiye to abhi bata dein.
entries.question: Raat Bakhair

entries.answer: Mera naam Ayna hai — matlab aaina. Main Maaz Arif ki banai hui AI voice assistant hoon, Product of Mazo Company.
entries.question: Aapka naam kya hai?

entries.answer: Teacher ne poocha: bijli kahan se aati hai? Bachay ne kaha: sir, hamari ammi kehti hain 'bijli ka bill aaya hai' — to bill se aati hogi!
entries.question: Koi mazak sunao

entries.answer: Main aapke phone mein rehti hoon! Mujhe Maaz Arif ne Pakistan mein banaya hai, aur main har jagah aapke saath hoon.
entries.question: Aap kahan se ho?

entries.answer: Koi baat nahi! Aap mujh se koi sawal pooch sakte hain, koi kahani sun sakte hain, ya koi naya topic seekh sakte hain. Kya karein — sawal, kahani ya seekhna?
entries.question: Main bore ho raha hoon

entries.answer: Namaz se pehle wudu karein, phir qibla ki taraf khare ho kar niyyat karein. Takbeer keh kar haath bandhein, Sana, Surah Fatiha aur koi Surah parhein, phir ruku, sajda aur qaada karein, aur aakhir mein salam pherein. Har namaz ki rakat alag hoti hain — pooch sakte hain.
entries.question: Namaz parhne ka tarika kya hai?

entries.answer: Wudu mein pehle niyyat karein, phir haath dhoyein, kulli karein, naak saaf karein, chehra teen martaba dhoyein, kohniyon tak haath dhoyein, sar ka masah karein, kaan saaf karein aur takhnon tak paon dhoyein. Wudu namaz ke liye zaroori hai.
entries.question: Wudu karne ka tarika kya hai?

entries.answer: Fajr ki namaz mein kul 4 rakat hain — 2 sunnat aur 2 farz. Fajr subah sawere, suraj nikalne se pehle parhi jati hai.
entries.question: Fajr ki namaz mein kitni rakat hain?

entries.answer: Zuhr ki namaz mein kul 12 rakat hain — 4 sunnat, 4 farz, 2 sunnat aur 2 nafil. Zuhr dopahar ke waqt parhi jati hai.
entries.question: Zuhr ki namaz mein kitni rakat hain?

entries.answer: Asr ki namaz mein kul 8 rakat hain — 4 sunnat-e-ghair-muakkada aur 4 farz. Asr dopahar ke baad, shaam se pehle parhi jati hai.
entries.question: Asr ki namaz mein kitni rakat hain?

entries.answer: Maghrib ki namaz mein kul 7 rakat hain — 3 farz, 2 sunnat aur 2 nafil. Maghrib suraj doobne ke foran baad parhi jati hai.
entries.question: Maghrib ki namaz mein kitni rakat hain?

entries.answer: Isha ki namaz mein kul 17 rakat hain — 4 sunnat, 4 farz, 2 sunnat, 2 nafil, 3 witr aur 2 nafil. Isha raat ko parhi jati hai.
entries.question: Isha ki namaz mein kitni rakat hain?

entries.answer: Jummah ki namaz mein 2 farz hote hain jo jamaat ke saath parhe jate hain, us se pehle khutba hota hai. Jummah se pehle 4 sunnat aur baad mein 4 sunnat aur 2 sunnat parhi jati hain. Jummah haftay ka sab se afzal din hai.
entries.question: Jummah ki namaz ka tarika kya hai?

entries.answer: Tahajjud raat ki nafil namaz hai jo aadhi raat ke baad parhi jati hai. Kam se kam 2 rakat aur zyada se zyada 12 rakat parh sakte hain. Yeh Allah se qareeb hone ki behtareen ibadat hai.
entries.question: Tahajjud ki namaz kya hai?

entries.answer: Namaz-e-Janaza mein 4 takbeerein hoti hain, is mein ruku aur sajda nahi hota. Pehli takbeer ke baad Sana, dosri ke baad Durood-e-Ibrahim, teesri ke baad marhoom ke liye dua, aur chauthi takbeer ke baad salam pherein.
entries.question: Namaz-e-Janaza ka tarika kya hai?

entries.answer: Sone ki dua hai: 'Allahumma bismika amootu wa ahya' — matlab: Aye Allah! Tere naam se marta hoon aur jeeta hoon. Sone se pehle yeh dua parhna sunnat hai.
entries.question: Sone ki dua kya hai?

entries.answer: Khane se pehle ki dua hai: 'Bismillah wa ala barakatillah'. Khane ke baad ki dua hai: 'Alhamdulillah hillazi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana minal muslimeen'.
entries.question: Khane ki dua kya hai?

entries.answer: Safar ki dua hai: 'Subhanallazi sakhkhara lana haza wa ma kunna lahu muqrineen, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon'. Safar se pehle yeh dua parhna sunnat hai.
entries.question: Safar ki dua kya hai?

entries.answer: Ayat-ul-Kursi Surah Al-Baqarah ki ayat number 255 hai. Yeh Quran ki sab se azeem ayat hai. Ise parhne se Allah ki hifazat milti hai, khaas tor par sone se pehle aur har farz namaz ke baad.
entries.question: Ayat-ul-Kursi kya hai?

entries.answer: Surah Ikhlas Quran ki 112 number surah hai. Yeh shuru hoti hai: 'Qul huwallahu ahad'. Is mein Allah ki wahdaniyat bayan hui hai, aur yeh Quran ke teesre hisse ke barabar sawab rakhti hai.
entries.question: Surah Ikhlas kya hai?

entries.answer: Surah Fatiha Quran ki pehli surah hai, jise 'Umm-ul-Kitab' bhi kehte hain. Yeh har rakat mein parhi jati hai aur shuru hoti hai: 'Alhamdu lillahi rabbil alameen'.
entries.question: Surah Fatiha kya hai?

entries.answer: Ramadan mein roza subah sehri se le kar maghrib tak khana peena chhodne ka naam hai. Yeh Islam ke 5 arkaan mein se aik hai aur is se sabr, taqwa aur ghareebon ka ehsaas seekha jata hai.
entries.question: Ramadan mein roza kya hai?

entries.answer: Sehri woh khana hai jo roza rakhne se pehle subah sawere khaya jata hai. Iftar woh khana hai jo maghrib ke waqt roza khola jata hai — aksar khajoor aur pani se roza khola jata hai.
entries.question: Sehri aur Iftar kya hai?

entries.answer: Eid-ul-Fitr Ramadan ke baad Shawwal ki pehli tareekh ko manayi jati hai. Is din Eid ki namaz parhi jati hai, naye kapre pehne jate hain aur khushiyan manayi jati hain. Eid se pehle Fitranah dena wajib hai.
entries.question: Eid-ul-Fitr kya hai?

entries.answer: Eid-ul-Adha Zil-Hajj ki 10 tareekh ko manayi jati hai. Is din Hajj ka ahem din hota hai aur qurbani di jati hai — Hazrat Ibrahim ki sunnat ki yaad mein bakra, gaaye ya oont ki qurbani hoti hai.
entries.question: Eid-ul-Adha kya hai?

entries.answer: Zakat Islam ka teesra rukn hai — maal ke aik makhsoos hisse ko saal guzarna par ghareebon ko dena. Zakat ki sharah aam tor par maal ka 2.5% hoti hai jab nisab poora ho.
entries.question: Zakat kya hai?

entries.answer: Hajj Islam ka paanchwan rukn hai — har saal Zil-Hajj ke mahine mein Makkah mein ada kiya jata hai. Jo musalman sehat aur maal ki istetaat rakhta ho, us par zindagi mein aik dafa Hajj farz hai.
entries.question: Hajj kya hai?

entries.answer: Istikhara woh namaz aur dua hai jo kisi ahem faisle se pehle Allah se khair mangne ke liye parhi jati hai. 2 rakat nafil parh kar Istikhara ki dua parhein, phir dil ke itminan par faisla karein.
entries.question: Istikhara kya hai?

entries.answer: Pehla Kalma hai: 'La ilaha illallahu Muhammadur Rasoolullah' — matlab: Allah ke siwa koi maabood nahi, Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain. Yeh Islam mein dakhil hone ki bunyad hai.
entries.question: Pehla Kalma kya hai?

entries.answer: 2 + 2 = 4 hota hai. Jamma karne ke liye dono numbers ko milayein — 2 aur 2 mil kar 4 bante hain.
entries.question: 2 + 2 kitna hota hai?

entries.answer: 7 x 8 = 56 hota hai. Zarab (multiplication) mein 7 ko 8 dafa jama karte hain, jo 56 banta hai.
entries.question: 7 x 8 kitna hota hai?

entries.answer: 10 x 10 = 100 hota hai. Kisi number ko 10 se zarab dein to us ke aakhir mein aik zero lag jata hai.
entries.question: 10 x 10 kitna hota hai?

entries.answer: Percentage nikalne ke liye number ko kul number se taqseem kar ke 100 se zarab dein. Misal: 50 mein se 25 ka percentage = (25 / 50) x 100 = 50%.
entries.question: Percentage kaise nikalte hain?

entries.answer: Taqseem (division) mein number ko barabar hisson mein baanta jata hai. Misal: 20 / 4 = 5, matlab 20 ko 4 barabar hisson mein baantein to har hissa 5 hoga.
entries.question: Taqseem kya hai?

entries.answer: Kisi number ka square us ko khud se zarab dene se banta hai. Misal: 5 ka square = 5 x 5 = 25. 9 ka square = 81.
entries.question: Square kya hota hai?

entries.answer: Fraction kisi cheez ka hissa batati hai. Misal: 1/2 matlab aadha, 1/4 matlab chautha hissa. Upar wala number numerator aur neechay wala denominator kehlata hai.
entries.question: Fraction kya hai?

entries.answer: Average nikalne ke liye sab numbers ko jama kar ke unki ginti se taqseem kar dein. Misal: 10, 20, 30 ka average = (10+20+30) / 3 = 20.
entries.question: Average kaise nikalte hain?

entries.answer: Odd numbers woh hain jo 2 se taqseem na hon — jaise 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. Even numbers 2 se poori tarah taqseem ho jate hain — jaise 2, 4, 6, 8, 10.
entries.question: Odd aur even number kya hain?

entries.answer: Pani ka chemical formula H2O hai — matlab aik pani ka molecule 2 hydrogen atoms aur 1 oxygen atom se banta hai. Pani zindagi ke liye sab se zaroori hai.
entries.question: Pani ka formula kya hai?

entries.answer: Photosynthesis woh amal hai jis se poday suraj ki roshni, pani aur carbon dioxide se apna khana banate hain aur oxygen chhodte hain. Isi liye poday hamari zindagi ke liye zaroori hain.
entries.question: Photosynthesis kya hai?

entries.answer: Gravity woh quwwat hai jo har cheez ko zameen ki taraf khainchti hai. Isi liye cheezein upar phenkne par neeche girti hain. Gravity ko Newton ne daryaft kiya tha.
entries.question: Gravity kya hai?

entries.answer: Oxygen woh gas hai jo hum saans mein lete hain aur zinda rehne ke liye zaroori hai. Hawa mein oxygen taqreeban 21% hoti hai, aur poday photosynthesis se oxygen banate hain.
entries.question: Oxygen kya hai?

entries.answer: Suraj hamare solar system ka markaz hai — aik bara sitara jo roshni aur garmi deta hai. Zameen suraj ke gird aik saal mein chakkar lagati hai.
entries.question: Suraj kya hai?

entries.answer: Chand zameen ka aik hi qamar (moon) hai jo zameen ke gird chakkar lagata hai. Chand ki roshni asal mein suraj ki roshni ka aks hai. Chand par pehli dafa insan 1969 mein gaya.
entries.question: Chand kya hai?

entries.answer: Hamare solar system mein 8 sayyare hain: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus aur Neptune. Zameen teesra sayyara hai aur Mars ko 'Red Planet' kehte hain.
entries.question: Solar system mein kitne sayyare hain?

entries.answer: Insan ke jism mein bade hone par 206 haddiyan hoti hain. Bachon mein haddiyan zyada hoti hain — taqreeban 300 — jo bade hote hue mil kar kam ho jati hain.
entries.question: Insan ke jism mein kitni haddiyan hoti hain?

entries.answer: Noun woh lafz hai jo kisi shakhs, jagah, cheez ya khayal ka naam bataye. Misal: Ali, Lahore, kitaab, khushi — yeh sab nouns hain.
entries.question: Noun kya hai?

entries.answer: Verb woh lafz hai jo koi kaam ya amal bataye. Misal: khana, parhna, daurna, likhna — yeh sab verbs hain. Har jumle mein aik verb hota hai.
entries.question: Verb kya hai?

entries.answer: Adjective woh lafz hai jo noun ki khoobi bataye. Misal: 'bara ghar', 'khoobsurat phool' — bara aur khoobsurat adjectives hain.
entries.question: Adjective kya hai?

entries.answer: Tense batata hai ke kaam kab hua — past (guzra waqt), present (haal) ya future (mustaqbil). Misal: 'I eat' present hai, 'I ate' past hai, 'I will eat' future hai.
entries.question: Tense kya hai?

entries.answer: 'A' aur 'An' aik cheez ke liye istemal hote hain — 'An' vowel (a, e, i, o, u) se shuru hone wale lafz se pehle aata hai, jaise 'an apple'. 'The' kisi khaas cheez ke liye aata hai, jaise 'the sun'.
entries.question: A, An aur The mein kya farq hai?

entries.answer: Urdu ka pehla harf 'Alif' (ا) hai. Urdu mein kul 39 haroof hain aur yeh daayein se baayein likhi jati hai. Urdu Pakistan ki qomi zuban hai.
entries.question: Urdu ka pehla harf kya hai?

entries.answer: Urdu Pakistan ki qomi zuban hai aur is mein boht khubsurat shairi likhi jati hai. Allama Iqbal aur Mirza Ghalib Urdu ke mashhoor shayar hain.
entries.question: Urdu zuban ke baare mein batayein

entries.answer: Pakistan 14 August 1947 ko bana tha. Is ke banane mein Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah ne sab se ahem kirdar ada kiya aur woh Pakistan ke pehle Governor General bane.
entries.question: Pakistan kab bana tha?

entries.answer: Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah Pakistan ke banane wale hain. Unhe 'Quaid-e-Azam' yani 'Sab se bara rehnuma' kaha jata hai. Unka mazaar Karachi mein hai.
entries.question: Quaid-e-Azam kaun thay?

entries.answer: Pakistan ka qomi tarana Hafeez Jalandhari ne likha tha aur is ki dhun Ahmed Ghulam Ali Chagla ne banai thi. Yeh 1954 mein manzoor hua tha.
entries.question: Pakistan ka qomi tarana kis ne likha?

entries.answer: Pakistan ka dar-ul-hukumat Islamabad hai. Yeh 1967 mein dar-ul-hukumat bana aur is ka naam 'Islam ka sheher' ke maani mein hai. Islamabad Pakistan ka sab se saaf suthra sheher mana jata hai.
entries.question: Pakistan ka dar-ul-hukumat kya hai?

entries.answer: Minar-e-Pakistan Lahore mein hai, jahan 23 March 1940 ko Pakistan ki qarardad manzoor hui thi. Is ki tameer 1960 mein shuru hui aur 1968 mein mukammal hui.
entries.question: Minar-e-Pakistan kahan hai?

entries.answer: Islam ke 5 arkaan hain: Kalma, Namaz, Roza, Zakat aur Hajj. Yeh har musalman ki zindagi ki bunyad hain.
entries.question: Islam ke kitne arkaan hain?

entries.answer: Quran ki pehli surah Surah Fatiha hai aur aakhri surah Surah An-Nas hai. Quran mein kul 114 suratein hain aur yeh Hazrat Muhammad par nazil hua.
entries.question: Quran mein kitni suratein hain?

entries.answer: Pakistan ka dar-ul-hukumat Islamabad hai, sab se bara sheher Karachi hai, aur qomi zuban Urdu hai. Pakistan ki currency Pakistani Rupee hai.
entries.question: Pakistan ke baare mein batayein

entries.answer: Karachi Pakistan ka sab se bara sheher hai aur pehle dar-ul-hukumat bhi tha. Yeh samundar ke kinare hai aur Pakistan ka sab se bara bandargah yahin hai.
entries.question: Pakistan ka sab se bara sheher kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: Markhor Pakistan ka qomi janwar hai. Yeh aik pahari bakra hai jo KP aur Gilgit-Baltistan ke paharon mein milta hai aur is ke bare seeng hote hain.
entries.question: Pakistan ka qomi janwar kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: Chakor Pakistan ka qomi parinda hai. Yeh aik khubsurat pahari parinda hai jo khaas tor par pahari ilaqon mein milta hai.
entries.question: Pakistan ka qomi parinda kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: Chambeli (Jasmine) Pakistan ka qomi phool hai. Yeh safed rang ka khushbudar phool hai jo pure Pakistan mein ugta hai.
entries.question: Pakistan ka qomi phool kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: Aam Pakistan ka qomi phal hai. Pakistan ke aam duniya bhar mein mashhoor hain, khaas tor par Chaunsa aur Sindhri. Aam garmiyon ka phal hai.
entries.question: Pakistan ka qomi phal kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: Pakistan mein kul 4 soobe hain: Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa aur Balochistan. Is ke ilawa Gilgit-Baltistan aur Azad Kashmir bhi hain.
entries.question: Pakistan mein kitne soobe hain?

entries.answer: Darya-e-Sindh (Indus River) Pakistan ka sab se lamba darya hai, taqreeban 3,180 km lamba. Yeh Pakistan ki zindagi ki rag hai kyun ke is se kheti ke liye pani milta hai.
entries.question: Pakistan ka sab se lamba darya kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: K2 Pakistan ki sab se unchi choti hai, 8,611 meter unchi. Yeh duniya ki dosri sab se unchi choti hai aur Gilgit-Baltistan mein hai.
entries.question: Pakistan ki sab se unchi choti kaun si hai?

entries.answer: Field Hockey Pakistan ka qomi khel hai. Pakistan ne hockey mein 3 dafa Olympic gold medal jeeta hai aur 4 dafa World Cup bhi jeeta hai.
entries.question: Pakistan ka qomi khel kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: Allama Iqbal Pakistan ke qomi shayar hain. Unhone 1930 mein Allahabad mein Pakistan ka khayal pesh kiya aur 'Shikwa' aur 'Jawab-e-Shikwa' unki mashhoor nazmein hain.
entries.question: Pakistan ke qomi shayar kaun hain?

entries.answer: Lahore Punjab ka dar-ul-hukumat aur Pakistan ka dil kehlata hai. Yahan Badshahi Masjid, Shahi Qila aur Minar-e-Pakistan hain. Lahore ka khana aur tehzeeb duniya bhar mein mashhoor hai.
entries.question: Lahore ke baare mein batayein

entries.answer: Russia duniya ka sab se bara mulk hai, raqbe ke lehaz se. Is ke baad Canada aur phir China aate hain.
entries.question: Duniya ka sab se bara mulk kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: Pacific Ocean duniya ka sab se bara samundar hai. Yeh duniya ke kul pani ka taqreeban aadha hissa hai aur is mein Marianas Trench bhi hai jo sab se gehra hissa hai.
entries.question: Duniya ka sab se bara samundar kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: Mount Everest duniya ka sab se uncha pahad hai, 8,849 meter uncha. Yeh Nepal aur China ki sarhad par Himalaya mein hai.
entries.question: Duniya ka sab se uncha pahad kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: Duniya mein kul 7 continents hain: Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe aur Australia. Asia sab se bara continent hai.
entries.question: Duniya mein kitne continents hain?

entries.answer: Sahara duniya ka sab se bara garam sehra hai, jo Africa mein hai. Yeh taqreeban 9 million square km mein phaila hai — America se bhi bara.
entries.question: Duniya ka sab se bara sehra kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: Cheetah zameen par sab se tez janwar hai, 100 km/h se zyada tez daur sakta hai. Yeh Africa mein milta hai aur shikar ke liye apni raftaar istemal karta hai.
entries.question: Sab se tez janwar kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: Blue Whale duniya ka sab se bara janwar hai, 30 meter tak lambi aur 200 ton tak wazni. Yeh samundar mein rehti hai aur machli nahi, aik mammal hai.
entries.question: Duniya ka sab se bara janwar kaun sa hai?

entries.answer: Insan ka dil aik minute mein taqreeban 70 dafa dharakta hai. Dil khoon ko pure jism mein pump karta hai aur zindagi ke liye sab se zaroori hissa hai.
entries.question: Insan ka dil kitni dafa dharakta hai?

entries.answer: Zameen apne mehwar par 24 ghante mein aik chakkar lagati hai, is se din aur raat bante hain. Suraj ke gird chakkar lagane mein 365 din lagte hain, is se saal banta hai.
entries.question: Din aur raat kaise bante hain?

entries.answer: Insan pehli dafa chand par 20 July 1969 ko gaya tha. Neil Armstrong pehle insan thay jinhone chand par qadam rakha aur kaha: 'Yeh insan ke liye chhota qadam hai, lekin insaaniyat ke liye bara qadam hai.'
entries.question: Insan pehli dafa chand par kab gaya?

entries.answer: Mars ko 'Red Planet' kehte hain kyun ke is ki mitti mein loha (iron) hai jo zang ki wajah se laal dikhta hai. Mars zameen ke baad woh sayyara hai jis par insan jane ki koshish kar raha hai.
entries.question: Mars ko Red Planet kyun kehte hain?

entries.answer: Roshni ki raftaar 300,000 km per second hai — duniya mein sab se tez cheez. Suraj ki roshni ko zameen tak aane mein taqreeban 8 minute lagte hain.
entries.question: Roshni ki raftaar kitni hai?

entries.answer: Cricket mein har team mein 11 khilari hote hain. Aik match mein batting, bowling aur fielding hoti hai. Pakistan ne Cricket World Cup 1992 mein jeeta tha.
entries.question: Cricket mein kitne khilari hote hain?

entries.answer: Football mein har team mein 11 khilari hote hain. Football duniya ka sab se zyada khela jane wala khel hai aur is ka World Cup har 4 saal baad hota hai.
entries.question: Football mein kitne khilari hote hain?

entries.answer: Olympics duniya ke sab se bare khelon ka muqabla hai jo har 4 saal baad hota hai. Pakistan ne hockey mein Olympic gold medal jeete hain.
entries.question: Olympics kya hai?

entries.answer: Bukhar mein jism ka temperature 100.4°F (38°C) se zyada ho jata hai. Aaram karein, halka khana khayein aur pani zyada piyen. Agar bukhar 3 din se zyada rahe ya bahut tez ho to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Bukhar ho to kya karein?

entries.answer: Sardi aur zukam aam tor par virus se hota hai aur aik hafte mein theek ho jata hai. Garam pani piyen, aaram karein aur bheed se door rahein. Agar saans lene mein takleef ho to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Sardi zukam ka ilaj kya hai?

entries.answer: Khansi seene ki jalan ya infection ki wajah se hoti hai. Garam pani aur shehed se aaram mil sakta hai, aur dhuaan aur thandi hawa se bachein. Agar khansi 2 hafte se zyada rahe to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Khansi ka ilaj kya hai?

entries.answer: Sar dard aam tor par thakan, neend ki kami ya pani ki kami se hota hai. Aaram karein, pani piyen aur andhere mein sukoon se baithein. Agar sar dard baar baar ho ya bahut tez ho to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Sar dard ka ilaj kya hai?

entries.answer: Pait dard ki wajah kharab khana, gas ya infection ho sakti hai. Halka khana khayein, garam pani piyen aur aaram karein. Agar dard tez ho ya ulti aur dast bhi hon to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Pait dard ka ilaj kya hai?

entries.answer: Ulti hone par aaram karein aur thora thora kar ke pani piyen. Bhari khana na khayein aur khana khane ke foran baad laitne se bachein. Agar ulti baar baar ho ya khoon aaye to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Ulti ho to kya karein?

entries.answer: Dast mein jism se pani nikal jata hai, is liye ORS (namak aur cheeni wala pani) ya saaf pani baar baar piyen. Halka khana khayein aur masaledar khana na khayein. Agar dast 2 din se zyada rahe to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Dast ka ilaj kya hai?

entries.answer: Dehydration mein jism mein pani ki kami ho jati hai — munh sukhna, chakkar aana aur peshab kam hona is ki alamat hain. ORS aur saaf pani piyen. Agar haalat kharab ho to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Dehydration kya hai?

entries.answer: Zakhm se khoon beh raha ho to saaf kapre se zakhm par dabao dalein aur khoon rukne tak dabaye rakhein. Zakhm ko saaf pani se dhoyein aur saaf patti bandhein. Agar zakhm gehra ho ya khoon na ruke to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Zakhm se khoon beh raha ho to kya karein?

entries.answer: Jalne par us hisse ko foran 10 minute tak thande pani ke neeche rakhein. Barf seedha jale hue hisse par na lagayein aur chhaale na phodein. Agar jalna bara ho ya chehre par ho to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Jalne par kya karein?

entries.answer: Haddi tootne ki soorat mein us hisse ko bilkul na hilayein aur kisi cheez ka sahara de kar bandh dein. Dard kam karne ke liye barf lagayein aur foran hospital le jayein. Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Haddi toot jaye to kya karein?

entries.answer: Allergy mein jism kisi cheez — jaise dhool, khane ya dawa — par zyada react karta hai. Chheenk, kharish ya soojan ho sakti hai. Us cheez se door rahein jo allergy karti hai. Agar saans lene mein takleef ho to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Allergy kya hai?

entries.answer: Blood pressure khoon ki ragoon par dabao hai. Zyada namak, wazan aur tension se blood pressure barhta hai. Namak kam karein, rozana chalein aur wazan kam karein. Blood pressure check karwane ke liye Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Blood pressure kya hai?

entries.answer: Diabetes mein khoon mein cheeni ki miqdar zyada ho jati hai. Meetha kam khayein, rozana exercise karein aur khoon ki cheeni regular check karein. Diabetes ki dawa aur ilaj ke liye Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Diabetes kya hai?

entries.answer: Ache sehat ke liye rozana 7 se 8 ghante ki neend zaroori hai. Sone se pehle phone band karein aur waqt par soyein. Agar neend na aati ho to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Neend achi kaise lein?

entries.answer: Insan ko rozana taqreeban 8 glass pani peena chahiye. Pani jism ko saaf rakhta hai, jild achi rehti hai aur thakan kam hoti hai. Garmi mein aur zyada pani piyen. Pani ki kami ki alamat ho to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Rozana kitna pani peena chahiye?

entries.answer: Rozana 30 minute ki walk ya halki exercise sehat ke liye behtareen hai. Exercise dil ko mazboot karti hai, wazan kam karti hai aur neend behtar karti hai. Agar koi bimari ho to exercise shuru karne se pehle Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Exercise ke faide kya hain?

entries.answer: Daant dard mein garam namak wale pani se kulli karein aur thandi cheezon se bachein. Dard zyada ho to dard ki dawa na lein bina mashware ke — daant ka ilaj ke liye Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Daant dard ka ilaj kya hai?

entries.answer: Aaj ke mausam ki live forecast ke liye internet chahiye, jo abhi offline mode mein nahi hai. Internet on hote hi main aapko aapke sheher ka live mausam bata sakti hoon. Aam tor par Pakistan mein November mein thand shuru ho jati hai.
entries.question: Aaj ka mausam kaisa hai?

entries.answer: Monsoon woh hawa hai jo garmiyon mein samundar se aati hai aur Pakistan mein June se September tak barish laati hai. Monsoon ki barish se fasalon ko pani milta hai, lekin zyada barish se sailab bhi aa sakta hai.
entries.question: Monsoon kya hai?

entries.answer: Barish is liye hoti hai ke samundar aur zameen se pani bhaap ban kar upar jata hai, badal banta hai aur thanda hokar pani ki boondein ban kar neeche girta hai. Yeh pani ka cycle hai.
entries.question: Barish kyun hoti hai?

entries.answer: Pakistan mein sardiyan November se February tak hoti hain. Is dauran temperature kam ho jata hai, khaas tor par KP aur Punjab ke ilaqon mein. Sardiyon mein garam kapre pehnein aur bachon ka khayal rakhein.
entries.question: Pakistan mein sardiyan kab hoti hain?

entries.answer: Pakistan mein garmiyan April se September tak hoti hain aur temperature 40°C se bhi upar ja sakta hai. Garmi se bachne ke liye zyada pani piyen, dopahar mein dhoop se bachein aur halke kapre pehnein.
entries.question: Pakistan mein garmiyan kab hoti hain?

entries.answer: Pakistan mein 4 mausam hote hain: Bahar (March–April), Garmi (May–September), Khizan (October–November) aur Sardi (December–February). Har mausam ki apni khasiyat hai aur fasalon par asar parta hai.
entries.question: Pakistan mein kitne mausam hote hain?

entries.answer: Badal pani ki chhoti boondon aur barf ke zarron se bante hain jo hawa mein tairte hain. Jab boondein bhari ho jati hain to barish ki shakal mein neeche girti hain. Kale badal zyada barish laate hain.
entries.question: Badal kaise bante hain?

entries.answer: Andhi aur toofan tez hawa se aate hain, aksar barish aur bijli ke saath. Toofan ke waqt ghar ke andar rahein, darakht aur khambe se door rahein aur bijli ke aalaat band kar dein.
entries.question: Toofan mein kya karein?

entries.answer: Barf sardiyon mein pahari ilaqon mein parti hai, jaise Murree, Swat aur Gilgit. Barf tab parti hai jab temperature 0°C se neeche ho aur hawa mein nami ho. Barf se paharon ki khubsurti barh jati hai.
entries.question: Barf kab parti hai?

entries.answer: Garmi se bachne ke liye rozana 8 se 10 glass pani piyen, dopahar 12 se 3 baje tak dhoop mein na niklein, halke aur dheele kapre pehnein aur sir dhamp kar rakhein. Agar chakkar ya ulti ho to Doctor se mashwara karein.
entries.question: Garmi se kaise bachein?

entries.answer: Pakistan ke maidanon mein garmi zyada hoti hai aur paharon mein thand. Punjab aur Sindh mein garmiyan sakht hoti hain, KP aur Balochistan ke pahari ilaqon mein sardiyan sakht hoti hain. Monsoon se July–August mein barish hoti hai.
entries.question: Pakistan ke mausam ke baare mein batayein

entries.answer: Barish ke baad aasman mein indradhanush (rainbow) tab banta hai jab suraj ki roshni barish ki boondon se guzarti hai aur 7 rangon mein bikhar jati hai: laal, narangi, peela, hara, neela, jamuni aur baingani.
entries.question: Indradhanush kaise banta hai?

entries.answer: Gandam Punjab aur KP ki sab se ahem fasal hai. Is ki beejai October se November mein hoti hai aur katai April se May mein hoti hai. Achhi paidawar ke liye achha beej, waqt par khad aur pani zaroori hai.
entries.question: Gandam kab boyein?

entries.answer: Gandam ki katai April se May mein hoti hai jab dana sakht aur sunehra ho jaye. Katai ke baad fasal ko khushk karke thresher se dana nikala jata hai aur khushk jagah par rakha jata hai.
entries.question: Gandam ki katai kab hoti hai?

entries.answer: Dhan (chawal) ki beejai May se June mein hoti hai aur katai October se November mein hoti hai. Dhan ko zyada pani chahiye hota hai, is liye is ki kheti zyada tar Punjab ke un ilaqon mein hoti hai jahan pani zyada hai.
entries.question: Dhan (chawal) kab boyein?

entries.answer: Makai ki beejai garmiyon mein March se April aur kharif mein July mein hoti hai. Makai ko suraj aur pani zyada chahiye hota hai. Yeh janwaron ke chara ke liye bhi istemal hoti hai.
entries.question: Makai kab boyein?

entries.answer: Ganna ki beejai February se March mein hoti hai aur katai November se March tak hoti hai. Ganne ko zyada pani aur lamba waqt chahiye hota hai. Is se cheeni aur gur banta hai.
entries.question: Ganna kab boyein?

entries.answer: Kapas ki beejai April se May mein hoti hai aur chunai September se November tak hoti hai. Kapas ko garam aur khushk mausam pasand hai aur yeh Pakistan ki ahem cash crop hai.
entries.question: Kapas kab boyein?

entries.answer: Sabziyan — jaise tamatar, piyaz, aloo aur gobhi — saal bhar mukhtalif mausam mein ugti hain. Sardiyon ki sabziyan September–October mein aur garmiyon ki sabziyan February–March mein boi jati hain.
entries.question: Sabziyan kab boyein?

entries.answer: Khad fasal ko taqat deti hai — urea, DAP aur potash aam khadein hain. Khad waqt par aur sahi miqdar mein dalein, zyada khad bhi fasal ko nuqsan de sakti hai. Mitti ki jaanch karwa kar khad lagayein.
entries.question: Khad kab aur kitni lagayein?

entries.answer: Fasal ko pani us waqt dein jab zameen ki upar wali teh khushk ho jaye. Subah ya shaam ko pani dena behtar hai. Zyada pani se jad sadh sakti hai aur kam pani se fasal murjha sakti hai.
entries.question: Fasal ko pani kab dein?

entries.answer: Keet aur bimari se fasal bachane ke liye beej ka intekhab acha karein, fasalon ko badal badal kar lagayein aur kharab podon ko foran nikaal dein. Dawa sirf zaroorat par aur sahi tareeqe se istemal karein.
entries.question: Fasal ko keet se kaise bachayein?

entries.answer: Acha beej woh hai jo saaf, bara aur sehatmand ho aur kisi mashhoor zariye se liya gaya ho. Beej khareedne se pehle us ki qism aur paidawar ki maloomat lein. Apna beej hamesha khushk aur thandi jagah par rakhein.
entries.question: Acha beej kaise pehchanein?

entries.answer: Zarkhez mitti naram, gehri aur kaale rang ki hoti hai jis mein nami aur khad ho. Mitti ko hal chala kar naram karein aur purani fasal ki baqiyat mitti mein milayein — is se mitti zarkhez hoti hai.
entries.question: Achi mitti kaisi hoti hai?

entries.answer: Aloo ki beejai sardiyon mein October se November mein hoti hai aur katai February se March mein hoti hai. Aloo ko naram aur retli mitti pasand hai aur paani ki zyada zaroorat hoti hai.
entries.question: Aloo kab boyein?

entries.answer: Piyaz ki beejai October se November mein hoti hai aur katai April se May mein hoti hai. Piyaz ko khushk mausam pasand hai aur katai ke baad ise achi tarah khushk karke rakhein ta ke kharab na ho.
entries.question: Piyaz kab boyein?

entries.answer: Tamatar ki beejai February se March aur August se September mein hoti hai. Tamatar ko suraj aur pani zyada chahiye hota hai aur ise sahara de kar lagayein ta ke phal zameen par na gire.
entries.question: Tamatar kab boyein?

entries.answer: Aam garmiyon ka sab se mashhoor phal hai. Aam ke bagh mein darakht ko sardiyon mein pani kam dein aur garmiyon mein zyada. Chaunsa aur Sindhri Pakistan ki mashhoor qismein hain.
entries.question: Aam ke baagh ki dekh bhaal kaisi karein?

entries.answer: Zameen ki tayari ke liye pehle hal chalayein, phir khad milayein aur zameen ko hamwar karein. Achhi tayari se beej achi tarah ugta hai aur pani barabar taqseem hota hai.
entries.question: Zameen ki tayari kaise karein?

entries.answer: Fasal ko store karne se pehle achi tarah khushk karein aur saaf boriyon ya dabon mein rakhein. Storage ki jagah khushk, thandi aur choohon se mehfooz honi chahiye. Nami se fasal kharab ho jati hai.
entries.question: Fasal ko store kaise karein?

entries.answer: WhatsApp par message bhejne ke liye keh dein: 'Ayna, WhatsApp par [naam] ko message bhejo ke [message]'. Main khud WhatsApp khol kar message type karke bhej dungi. Ya aap khud WhatsApp khol kar chat par tap karein, message likhein aur send ka button dabayein.
entries.question: WhatsApp par message kaise bhejein?

entries.answer: WhatsApp status lagane ke liye WhatsApp khol kar 'Status' tab par tap karein, phir camera icon par tap kar ke photo ya video chunein, caption likhein aur send kar dein. Status 24 ghante ke baad khatam ho jata hai.
entries.question: WhatsApp status kaise lagayein?

entries.answer: Screenshot lene ke liye power button aur volume down button ko aik saath dabayein aur aik second ke liye rakhein. Screenshot gallery mein save ho jayega. Kuch phone mein teen ungliyon se neeche swipe karne se bhi screenshot liya jata hai.
entries.question: Screenshot kaise lein?

entries.answer: WiFi connect karne ke liye Settings mein jayein, WiFi par tap karein, apna network chunein aur password dalein. WiFi on hone par aap internet istemal kar sakte hain aur Ayna ki online madad le sakte hain.
entries.question: WiFi kaise connect karein?

entries.answer: Bluetooth on karne ke liye Settings mein jayein ya upar se notification panel neeche kheench kar Bluetooth icon par tap karein. Phir jis device se connect karna ho, use chunein aur pair karein.
entries.question: Bluetooth kaise connect karein?

entries.answer: Battery bachane ke liye screen ki brightness kam karein, jo apps istemal nahi kar rahe unhe band karein aur Battery Saver on karein. WiFi aur Bluetooth jab zaroorat na ho to band rakhein.
entries.question: Battery kaise bachayein?

entries.answer: Storage khali karne ke liye Settings > Storage mein jayein aur purani photos, videos aur apps delete karein. WhatsApp mein purani media bhi delete kar sakte hain — pehle zaroori cheezein backup kar lein.
entries.question: Phone ki storage kaise khali karein?

entries.answer: App delete karne ke liye app ke icon par der tak dabayein aur 'Uninstall' par tap karein. Ya Settings > Apps mein ja kar jis app ko hatana ho, use chunein aur Uninstall dabayein.
entries.question: App kaise delete karein?

entries.answer: Phone slow ho to pehle phone ko restart karein, phir purani apps aur cache delete karein. Settings > Storage > Cached data clear karein. Agar phir bhi slow ho to zaroori data backup kar ke phone reset karne ka sochein.
entries.question: Phone slow ho gaya hai to kya karein?

entries.answer: Agar aap pattern ya password bhool gaye hain to phone ko recovery mode mein reset karna parta hai — lekin is se data delete ho jata hai. Is liye password ya pattern hamesha kisi mehfooz jagah par likh kar rakhein.
entries.question: Phone ka password bhool gaya hoon

entries.answer: Contact save karne ke liye Phone app khol kar 'Contacts' par tap karein, phir '+' ka button dabayein, naam aur number likhein aur Save kar dein. Aap keh bhi sakte hain: 'Ayna, [naam] ka number save karo'.
entries.question: Naya contact kaise save karein?

entries.answer: Kisi number ko block karne ke liye us ki chat ya call history mein number par tap karein aur 'Block' par tap karein. Block karne ke baad us number se call aur message nahi aayenge.
entries.question: Kisi number ko block kaise karein?

entries.answer: Ayna aik AI voice assistant hai — aapki aaina. Is se aap sirf bol kar WhatsApp message bhej sakte hain, call accept ya reject kar sakte hain, SMS bhej sakte hain, reminder laga sakte hain aur sawal pooch sakte hain.
entries.question: Ayna kya hai?

entries.answer: Ayna ko Maaz Arif ne banaya hai — woh Ayna ke Founder hain. Ayna Product of Mazo Company hai aur Pakistan mein banai gayi hai.
entries.question: Ayna kis ne banayi hai?

entries.answer: Ayna ki qeemat sirf Rs 300 aik dafa hai — us ke baad hamesha ke liye aapki. Pehle 10 din bilkul muft trial hai, us ke baad Rs 300 Easypaisa se pay kar ke permanent unlock karein.
entries.question: Ayna ki qeemat kitni hai?

entries.answer: Ayna 10 din ke liye bilkul muft hai — free trial. 10 din ke baad Rs 300 aik dafa pay kar ke hamesha ke liye unlock kar lein. Trial khatam hone par app aapko payment ki tafseel dikha de gi.
entries.question: Ayna ka free trial kitne din ka hai?

entries.answer: Ayna ka wake word 'Ayna' hai — bas 'Ayna' ya 'Hello Ayna' keh dein aur main sunne lagungi. Phir jo bhi kaam ho, bol kar batayein.
entries.question: Ayna ko kaise bulayein?

entries.answer: Ayna yeh sab kar sakti hai: WhatsApp message bhejna, call accept ya reject karna, SMS bhejna, reminder lagana, sawal ke jawab dena aur live maloomat dena. Android par full control hai — iPhone par sirf voice chat, jawab aur reminders milte hain.
entries.question: Ayna kya kya kar sakti hai?

entries.answer: Ayna se WhatsApp message bhejne ke liye bas keh dein: 'Ayna, WhatsApp par [naam] ko message bhejo ke [message]'. Main WhatsApp khol kar message bhej dungi. Message bhejne ke liye internet chahiye.
entries.question: Ayna se WhatsApp message kaise bhejein?

entries.answer: Ayna se call accept ya reject karne ke liye bas keh dein: 'Ayna, call uthao' ya 'Ayna, call reject karo'. Yeh Android par kaam karta hai. iPhone par call handle nahi ho sakta.
entries.question: Ayna se call kaise accept ya reject karein?

entries.answer: Reminder lagane ke liye keh dein: 'Ayna, mujhe [waqt] par yaad dilana ke [kaam]'. Misal: 'Ayna, mujhe subah 7 baje yaad dilana ke namaz parhni hai'. Main waqt par aapko yaad dila dungi.
entries.question: Ayna se reminder kaise lagayein?

entries.answer: Ayna internet ke baghair bhi kaam karti hai — offline bank mein sawal-jawab, namaz, taleem, sehat aur kheti ki maloomat maujood hain. Internet hone par main live mausam, khabrein aur smart jawab bhi de sakti hoon.
entries.question: Ayna internet ke baghair kaam karti hai?

entries.answer: Payment Easypaisa se karni hai: Rs 300 number 0308 9303647 par bhejein, account naam Maaz Arif hai. Phir Ayna app mein apni Transaction ID likh kar submit karein — Maaz verify karke aapki licence permanent activate kar dein ge.
entries.question: Ayna ki payment kaise karein?

entries.answer: iPhone par Ayna sirf voice chat, sawal ke jawab aur reminders de sakti hai. WhatsApp mein tap karna, call accept/reject aur screen overlay Apple ki pabandi ki wajah se iPhone par nahi ho sakte — full control sirf Android par hai.
entries.question: iPhone par Ayna kya kar sakti hai?
